get.description:
The site's title, description and image, read by the server within 5 seconds and 1 MB.

A site that fails or is too slow gives only `url` and `domain`. A URL that is not http(s), or whose host or any
redirect points to a loopback, private, link-local, multicast or reserved address, is 422 `link_not_allowed`.

delete.description: Moves the node and everything under it to its base's trash.

get.description: The live node with its path, and a page's text or a file's current content.

patch.description: Renaming a page also fixes the `[[…]]` links that resolved to it; a description the person edits is locked.

post.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 10 MB becomes the cover of a folder or page.
A link to the node's uploaded cover image that opens without the key for 60 seconds.

get.description:
The node's uploaded cover image.

Takes the X-API-Key header or the `expires` and `signature` of a link from `POST /v1/nodes/{node_id}/cover/link`.

post.description: A copy of the page, "<título> (cópia)" right after it, with its text and its sub-pages; files are not copied.

get.description:
A page or folder and everything live under it as a zip: pages as their Markdown text, files as stored.

Takes the X-API-Key header or the `expires` and `signature` of a link from `POST /v1/nodes/{node_id}/export/link`.
A storage error breaks the download off instead of ending it as a shorter zip.

200.description: The zip, made as it is sent.

post.description: A link to the zip of a page or folder that opens without the key for 60 seconds.

put.description: Adds a page or folder to the favorites, last or just before `before_id`; a favorite already there moves.

post.description: Any file of at most 100 MB put in the page, outside the tree; over it is 422 `attachment_too_large`.
A link to the attachment's bytes that opens without the key for 60 seconds.

get.description:
The attachment byte for byte; one `Range` of bytes is honored.

Takes the X-API-Key header or the `expires` and `signature` of a link from
`POST /v1/pages/{node_id}/attachments/{name}/link`.

416.description: The range is outside the file.

post.description: The person left the page: the working text becomes a version, unless it already is one.

get.description: The pages of the base with a `[[…]]` link to this one, ordered by path, each with the line holding it.

schema.title: Response List Page Mentions V1 Pages  Node Id  Mentions Get

put.description:
Autosave of the working text. A 409 `stale_page` carries the newest `markdown` and `revision` in `details`;
the refused text was kept as a version.

get.description: The page's versions, newest first, without their text; the working text is cut as a version first.

schema.title: Response List Page Versions V1 Pages  Node Id  Versions Get
